To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the wound response in plants can be modulated by the immunomodulation of endogenous jasmonate.

transgenic tobacco plants expressing anti-JA single-chain antibodies in the cytosolic compartment are insensitive to JA treatment and are unable to induce JA-responsive genes upon wounding, indicating that cytosolic JA is an essential signal in the wound response.
transgenic tobacco plants expressing anti-JA antibodies show JA-deficient phenotypies and that JA is essential for the wound response in tobacco.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a new method to manipulate plant responses and to study JA function.
the identification and characterization of JA as a signal molecule in the plant wound response.
a better understanding of the mode of action of jasmonates in the wound response and provides a tool for manipulating plant responses to wounding.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
JA is a key signal in the wound response.
JA is a signal in plant stress responses, but that it is not a master regulator.
the wound response of Nicotiana tabaccum is regulated in a compartment-specific manner.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the jasmonate level in planta is a crucial factor for the wound response and that the jasmonates are perceived and transduced as a whole, not as a single molecule.
the wound response of plants is controlled by a delicate balance between the biosynthesis and degradation of the signal compound JA.
the wound response of plants is a result of a fine-tuning of JA biosynthesis and perception.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of antibodies to modulate endogenous hormone levels can be a valuable tool in dissecting the role of hormones in plant development and stress signalling.
immunomodulation of the jasmonate pathway in plants can be used as a tool to dissect the role of this important plant hormone in plant development and stress responses.
JA immunomodulation can be used as an alternative approach to study the role of JA in plant stress responses.
